description: Every action the system or the user is tracking, across all modules. The one file a seller opens daily.

columns.name: title
columns.note: Imperative and specific: 'Send pricing follow-up to Jane Doe (Acme)'

columns.name: automation
columns.note: auto = system acts; review = system drafts, you approve; manual = you do it

columns.name: related_id
columns.note: e.g. LEAD-0042, OPP-0031. The link back to the record.

columns.name: account_name
columns.note: Denormalised on purpose so the spreadsheet reads without lookups

columns.name: created_by
columns.note: 'user' or the skill that raised it, e.g. 'daily-brief'

columns.name: why
columns.note: One line of justification. Tasks with no reason get ignored and erode trust.

columns.name: draft_path
columns.note: Relative path to the drafted email or asset awaiting approval

columns.name: verify_by
columns.note: How the system can tell this got done, including manually

columns.name: verify_target
columns.note: What to look for: an email address, a meeting title, a CRM field

columns.name: completion_evidence
columns.note: Human-readable proof, e.g. 'email to jane@acme.com sent 2026-08-04 09:12'

columns.name: external_system
columns.note: Where else this task lives: todoist, reminders, asana, etc. Blank = this folder only.

columns.name: external_id
columns.note: That system's id for this task, so a two-way bridge can match without guessing.
